The RTE shall calculate the needed buffer size for the output on which COMBased data transformation applies by using ceil((end −start)/8), where: • end is the ISignalToIPduMapping.startPosition plus the ISignal. length of the last ISignal of the ISignalGroup (the ISignal of this ISig- nalGroup having the highest ISignalToIPduMapping.startPosition in the related ISignalIPdu), and • start is the ISignalToIPduMapping.startPosition of the first ISignal of the ISignalGroup (the ISignal of this ISignalGroup having the lowest ISignalToIPduMapping.startPosition in the related ISignalIPdu).
